name: opencodex
install:
if [ ! -x "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" ]; then curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s "bun-v1.4.0"; fi
export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
sudo -n ln -sfn "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun
sudo -n ln -sfn "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bunx
bun install --frozen-lockfile
bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd gui
